explanation: The request arrived on Wednesday, 30 June 2027, twelve days before the examination on Monday, 12 July 2027, and the registration confirmation shows the first attempt. Under § 3(1) a student may withdraw without giving reasons until the seventh calendar day before the examination (5 July 2027). The withdrawal is granted.

The learning agreement was approved on 14 July 2026, before the stay began on 6 September 2026, and the transcript shows its four modules as passed (5.0 or higher out of 10). Renewable Energy Systems is not listed in the learning agreement, so § 7(1) excludes its 6 credits. The office recognizes 21 credits (6 + 6 + 4 + 5).

The examination took place on Tuesday, 4 May 2027, and Thursday, 6 May 2027 was a public holiday in Hessen (Ascension Day), so the third working day after the examination was Monday, 10 May 2027, the day the certificate arrived. The physician examined the student on the examination date and certifies unfitness for examinations on that date, as § 4(2) requires. The illness is accepted under § 4(1).

The supervisor confirms in writing that the mass spectrometer was out of service from 15 March 2027 to 23 April 2027, a reason beyond the student's control under § 6(2), and the request arrived before the deadline of 21 June 2027. The student asks for eight weeks, but § 6(3) limits the extension of a Master's thesis to six weeks. The new deadline is Monday, 2 August 2027.

The request arrived on Monday, 12 July 2027, nine days before the examination on Wednesday, 21 July 2027, so it is on time under § 2(2). The student missed the registration period because of a hiking trip, however, and § 2(3) names travel as a reason that does not justify late registration; no document is attached either. Late registration is denied.

The record shows one failed attempt at Theoretical Computer Science on 15 February 2027. Under § 5(1) a failed examination may be repeated twice, so the student may register for the second attempt on 19 July 2027 and has two attempts left. The counselling interview of § 5(4) is needed only before a third attempt.

The registration confirmation shows that the examination on Monday, 26 July 2027 is the student's third attempt. Under § 3(3) the withdrawal without reasons of § 3(1) does not apply to a third attempt, and not feeling ready is a lack of preparation, which § 3(2) excludes as a reason. The withdrawal is denied.

The stay at Norrvik University of Technology began on 23 August 2026, but the examination office approved the learning agreement only on 7 October 2026. Under § 7(1) credits are recognized only for modules in a learning agreement approved before the stay began, so none of the 15 credits can be recognized. The request is denied.

The student asks for three more weeks because the student job took more time in May 2027. Under § 6(2) workload from employment is not a reason for an extension, although the request arrived before the deadline of 25 June 2027. The request is denied.

The student missed the examination on Thursday, 18 February 2027 and sent the certificate the next day, within the deadline of § 4(1). The physician examined the student only on Friday, 19 February 2027 and certifies unfitness from that day, so the certificate does not cover the examination date as § 4(2) requires. The illness is not accepted.

The hospital letter shows an inpatient stay from 22 June 2027 to 12 July 2027. This stay covers the whole registration period for the examination on Friday, 23 July 2027 (25 June 2027 to 9 July 2027), and the request arrived on 14 July 2027, before the seventh calendar day before the examination. Late registration is granted under § 2(3).

The record shows that the student passed Microeconomics on 22 July 2026 with the grade 3.7. Under § 5(3) a passed examination cannot be repeated, not even to improve the grade. The request is denied, and no attempts remain for this module examination.

The learning agreement was approved on 10 December 2026, before the stay began on 1 February 2027, and all three listed modules were passed (15 credits). The learning agreement also records 84 credits recognized earlier, and § 7(4) limits recognized credits in a Bachelor's programme to 90 in total. The office recognizes 6 credits.

The medical certificate shows an illness from 12 April 2027 to 25 April 2027, a reason under § 6(2), and the request for two weeks arrived before the deadline of Monday, 3 May 2027. Two weeks after the deadline is Monday, 17 May 2027, Whit Monday, a public holiday in Hessen. Under § 6(5) the new deadline is Tuesday, 18 May 2027.

The request arrived on Friday, 23 July 2027, three days before the examination on Monday, 26 July 2027, after the withdrawal without reasons of § 3(1) had ended on 19 July 2027. Under § 3(2) a later withdrawal needs a documented reason beyond the student's control, and a move and a lack of preparation are excluded. The withdrawal is denied.
